subject: Photo booth service
text:
Hi,

I need help with the club photo booth service. The note says to reserve it early. I don’t know what “early” means. Is that two weeks? One week? Please tell me.

Our next event is in March. We may need three booths. We may need props. We may not. The form was unclear. The email link was unclear too.

Can you ask the vendor for a clear timeline? Can you get a simple price sheet? I will handle the club budget. You handle vendor emails for work.

I tried the portal. It blocked my login. It asked for a code. I have no code. I asked twice. No reply came. That feels wrong. Please check it soon.
